headline: Pantera Silver's shares resume trading after its cease-trade order was lifted
dek: The TSX Venture Exchange reinstated trading Thursday after Pantera filed financial statements and the B.C. Securities Commission revoked the order.
caption: A remote mountain exploration camp, representative of the Bolivian silver district Pantera Silver says is now its focus.

sources.title: Pantera Silver Announces Resumption of Trading on the TSX Venture Exchange

unverified_claims: The characterization of Pantera's renewed focus on the Rakanco Silver District rests on a quote attributed to the company's chief executive.
brief: The TSX Venture Exchange has reinstated trading in Pantera Silver Corp.'s common shares, with trading set to resume at market open on Thursday, November 5, 2026, the company said. Trading had been halted under a cease trade order from the British Columbia Securities Commission.

The commission revoked the cease trade order on October 13, 2026, after Pantera filed its audited annual financial statements for the year ended May 31, 2026, along with the related management's discussion and analysis and CEO and CFO certifications, the company said.
President and chief executive Jay Roberge said, "With our filings complete and trading restored, our focus is back on advancing the Rakanco Silver District in Bolivia."
body: The TSX Venture Exchange has reinstated trading in Pantera Silver Corp.'s common shares after a cease trade order imposed by the British Columbia Securities Commission, the company said. Trading is set to resume at market open on Thursday, November 5, 2026. Pantera's announcement follows news releases the company issued on October 6 and October 20, 2026.

The commission revoked the cease trade order on October 13, 2026, Pantera said, after the company filed its audited annual financial statements for the year ended May 31, 2026, together with the related management's discussion and analysis and the chief executive and chief financial officer certifications.

Jay Roberge, Pantera's president and chief executive, said in the release, "We thank our shareholders for their patience. With our filings complete and trading restored, our focus is back on advancing the Rakanco Silver District in Bolivia."
